description: Replace the server-side code of an existing roost. Advanced — most agents should use `upload` (for static files) or `convert` (for renames) instead. Pass `hatchId`, `workerName`, and a full ES module `script` (text only, 1.5 MiB max).

approvalId.description: Tier-2 phone approval id from a prior deploy attempt.

hatchId.description: Hatch id from the original hatch response.

policy.description: HITL policy override. Under `required`, may fork a sibling `{slug}-vN`.

sessionToken.description: Optional paired session token from poll_pairing (when Authorization headers are unavailable).

name: deploy
title: Replace site code (advanced)
